description: A session's scenes by rank, 1 to n, for session preparation, the Médias page and the table: each with its id, its order, its title, the ids of its places, characters (PCs and NPCs) and events, the ids of its media, the ids of the elements still to create, its notes and its battlemap. The media of a scene are the ones linked to it directly and the ones whose place is one of its places — derived at read time, never stored — and a medium with no place is attached to nothing. A scene's battlemap is the id of its battlemap instance (battlemap_instance.scene_id), the most recently created one when there are several, an instance whose partition (BattlemapInstance/<id>) is tombstoned left out; null when the scene has none.
output: { id: string, order: number, title: string, places: string[], characters: string[], events: string[], media: string[], toCreate: string[], battlemap: string | null, notes: string | null }[]
